notes.title: 🛠️ Project Update – July 2025
notes.notes:
✅ What’s already done:
🧱 Level design and mapping are finished: every corner of the abandoned hospital is now in place, ready to be explored (or escaped).

🎬 The official teaser is complete and published: you can now get a glimpse of the atmosphere, the tension, and what awaits in the shadows…
[hr][/hr]🧪 What we’re working on now:
🧩 The playable demo: a solo version is in development. You’ll be able to explore the hospital, searching for a mysterious key… but don’t expect to escape so easily.

🎧 Sound reaction system: the creature doesn’t like noise. We’re working on a feature where it reacts to your footsteps, dropped items, or heavy breathing…

🎥 Facial recognition: yes, really. In the full version, the game may react to your expressions. Fear, tension, micro-reactions… it’s all being watched.
[hr][/hr]🔜 What’s next?
We’re focusing on making a stable, immersive and frightening demo. Stay tuned, follow the page, and most importantly…

Don’t make a sound. He’s listening.

— The development team 🖤
